reports.blind_spot_notes: Five-question framework: Peabody (fair line, independent Poisson with Dixon-Coles correction, blended with a de-vigged ESPN line, model weight n/(n+10) capped at 0.5), Walters (+2% net vs fair or pass, quarter-Kelly on a 100u bank), Spanky (who moved the line first; rec-only moves get faded), Voulgaris (behavioral/style read the rating misses), Captain Jack (a specific book and price, not a team name). Full 18-game Matchday 1 slate (Tue Sep 8 / Wed Sep 9 / Thu Sep 10) was evaluated with real domestic-season weighting instead of UCL's own reset-to-zero played counter. The strict dual-threshold read (confidence >=60% AND edge >=3pp) cleared nothing, mainly because moderate favorites this early in the season rarely carry both at once - heavy favorites are already priced fairly (no edge), true underdogs can't reach 60% confidence by definition.
